verdicts.reason: A has a clean vertical stack with a strong headline, but the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has moved below the body copy, so the reading order is wrong. It also mixes alignments: the text is left-aligned while the bottle and CTA are centred. The body copy leaves 'sparkling.' alone on its own line, and there is dead space at the top. B squeezes the body copy into a narrow column with one to two words per line ('Every / mixed / case of'). It also wraps the eyebrow onto two cramped lines jammed beside the headline, and the oversized bottle takes over the canvas, so the headline is no longer the main focal point.
